analysis:
All four units are documentation-only (docs/architecture/inference.md, docs/provider/cli-reference.md); no executable code, wire protocol, authorization, attestation or key-handling paths changed. The visible head text (lines 1645-2272) is the unchanged surrounding MiMo/Flint/Qwen4 documentation. The changed ranges, head 404-410 and 1050-1070 in inference.md, are not in my supplied text; I only saw their patch excerpt. That excerpt describes (a) a load-gate eviction path that first releases retained free KV segments and drops MLX's buffer cache (`releaseReclaimableMemoryForLoad`), and (b) segmented paged admission that parks free 64 MiB KV segments per pool, up to min(2 GiB, slot grant/8), outside the grant/ledger, and reinstalls them for the next admission of the same size class. New segments wrap zero-fill-on-demand host pages. The excerpt is truncated.

Security-relevant observations for later passes: the retained-segment reuse relates to T-028 (residual KV data in GPU memory) and T-041 (cross-tenant prefix cache). Parked segments are reinstalled without a visible zeroing step, and the excerpt does not show whether segments are cleared or whether reuse crosses request or tenant boundaries. T-028 already treats residual KV as accepted-risk-adjacent, so a doc description of reuse is not itself a regression. Memory held outside the ledger is a possible availability concern (TB-007), but it is bounded by the 2 GiB / grant/8 cap and reclaimed before load or eviction. The cli-reference.md patch adds three DARKBLOOM_TTFT_* env-var rows (IDLE_CACHE_SWEEP, SEGMENT_RETENTION, SEGMENT_HOST_ZEROS). They are documented as env knobs only; their default values and their effect on zeroing are not shown. If HOST_ZEROS or RETENTION can weaken zeroing semantics, the implementing code in GlobalKVCacheBudget.swift and EngineV2Factory+SegmentedBackend.swift needs review. That code is not in this batch. No finding is raised, since docs alone do not establish a regression. Recommend checking that the implementing source preserves or documents isolation of reused segments, and that T-028 is updated if reuse without zeroing is introduced.
